cases.title: The JSON schema an agent is given

expected.title: FinePrint Document
expected.description: A document: an optional title plus a flat list of blocks. Written to PDF by particle-academy/fine-print. The same model as particle-academy/last-word (.docx), without the chart block.

title.description: The document title, stored as PDF metadata and shown by a {title} token in a band. Not drawn in the body; write a heading for that.

meta.description: Document properties beyond the title (which is the top-level `title`).

author.description: The PDF's Author, and what an {author} token in a band shows.

page.description: Page geometry. One-inch margins by default. Mixed page shapes: a pageBreak with its own `page`.

header.description: A running header on every page: a one-line band, or blocks (a letterhead with a logo). With a firstHeader, every page but the first; with an evenHeader, the odd pages.

footer.description: A running footer on every page: where a multi-page document carries its page numbers. With a firstFooter, every page but the first; with an evenFooter, the odd pages.

firstHeader.description: The header of the FIRST page only, in place of header there. {"blocks": []} leaves that page with no header. On a pageBreak it means the first page after that break. Never inherited by a later break.

firstFooter.description: The footer of the first page only, in place of footer there. {"blocks": []} leaves that page with no footer. On a pageBreak it means the first page after that break. Never inherited by a later break.

evenHeader.description: The header of even pages; header is then the odd pages'. Follows the page number, which runs through the whole document and does not restart at a break.

evenFooter.description: The footer of even pages; footer is then the odd pages'. Follows the page number, which runs through the whole document and does not restart at a break.

background.description: Page colour, painted full-bleed on every page under everything else, e.g. "#FDFAF3". White (none) by default. One per document: refused on a pageBreak.

border.description: A frame around every page, measured from the page edge, so it is the same whatever the page holds (a certificate border). e.g. {"style": "double", "width": 6, "color": "#B08D57", "inset": 18}. Margins are separate: keep them wider than inset + width so text clears the frame.

style.description: single by default; double draws two rules with a gap, each a third of the width; none draws nothing.

width.description: Points, the whole frame (both rules and the gap, for double). 0.5 by default.

inset.description: Points from the page edge to the outside of the frame. 24 by default.

defaultFont.description: Font every run inherits unless it names its own. Helvetica by default.

defaultSize.description: Size in points every run inherits; 11 by default.

text.description: The text. A "\n" starts a new line within the paragraph.

code.description: Inline code: Courier on a light grey ground.

smallCaps.description: Accepted for last-word compatibility; not drawn in a PDF yet (lint says so).

link.description: Hyperlink target: an http://, https:// or mailto: URL. No other scheme is accepted.

size.description: Font size in points, at least 1.

font.description: Font family: Helvetica, Times or Courier (and their usual aliases, such as Arial, Times New Roman, Courier New), or a family the host registered.

letterSpacing.description: Tracking in points; may be negative.

spaceAfter.description: Points. Zero is meaningful: the default puts 8pt under every paragraph.

keepNext.description: Keep on the same page as the block after it. Headings keep with their next block by default.

border.description: One border edge. {"style":"none"} REMOVES a border; a zero width is not it.

boxBorders.description: Box edges. Anything omitted is left alone rather than reset.

tableBorders.description: Table edges: the box, plus the two inside directions.

boxSides.description: Box spacing in points. Anything omitted is left alone.

pageMargins.description: Page margins in points, 72 (one inch) each side by default, and the header and footer DISTANCES: how far the header sits from the top edge of the page and the footer from the bottom edge, 36 by default. A blocks band taller than the margin leaves room for moves the body down (or up), on the pages that draw it; a one-line band never does.

header.description: Points from the top edge of the page to the top of the header. 36 by default.

footer.description: Points from the bottom edge of the page to the bottom of the footer. 36 by default.

footnote.description: A footnote, carried by a run whose text is "" and which sits where the reference mark goes: {"text": "", "footnote": {"blocks": [{"type": "paragraph", "runs": [{"text": "Audited figures, FY2026."}]}]}}. Marks number 1, 2, 3 in reading order, and each note is set at the foot of the page that holds its mark, at 10pt. The blocks are the body vocabulary less pageBreak, with no footnote inside a footnote. Not in a header or footer.

band.description: A running header or footer: one line with a left, a centre and a right slot, e.g. {"left": "Q3 Board Memo | Confidential", "right": "Page {page} of {pages}"}. 9pt grey unless size/color say otherwise.

left.description: Text with live tokens: {page} and {pages} ("Page {page} of {pages}", the document's own numbering and total), {section} (which stretch of pages this is, counting one per pageBreak with a page) and {sectionpages} (that stretch's page count), {title} and {author} (meta.author). A PDF has no live date: {date}, {time} and {filename} are written as literal text and reported in warnings. Anything else in braces is literal text.

center.description: Text with live tokens: {page} and {pages} ("Page {page} of {pages}", the document's own numbering and total), {section} (which stretch of pages this is, counting one per pageBreak with a page) and {sectionpages} (that stretch's page count), {title} and {author} (meta.author). A PDF has no live date: {date}, {time} and {filename} are written as literal text and reported in warnings. Anything else in braces is literal text.

right.description: Text with live tokens: {page} and {pages} ("Page {page} of {pages}", the document's own numbering and total), {section} (which stretch of pages this is, counting one per pageBreak with a page) and {sectionpages} (that stretch's page count), {title} and {author} (meta.author). A PDF has no live date: {date}, {time} and {filename} are written as literal text and reported in warnings. Anything else in braces is literal text.

blocksBand.description: A running header or footer that holds blocks, the body's own vocabulary less pageBreak at any depth, for what one line cannot: a logo, a table, a line with a rule under it. e.g. {"blocks": [{"type": "image", "src": "data:image/png;base64,...", "widthPx": 96}, {"type": "paragraph", "align": "right", "runs": [{"text": "Page {page}", "size": 8}]}]}. Tokens in run text are live, in a table cell too. Set at the page's own width, between its left and right margins. Never mixed with left/center/right/size/color.

oneOf.description: A heading is a paragraph and takes the same properties. Bold, 18/16/14/13/12/11pt by level.

spaceAfter.description: Points. Zero is meaningful: the default puts 8pt under every paragraph.

keepNext.description: Keep on the same page as the block after it. Headings keep with their next block by default.

spaceAfter.description: Points. Zero is meaningful: the default puts 8pt under every paragraph.

keepNext.description: Keep on the same page as the block after it. Headings keep with their next block by default.

widths.description: Relative column weights: [30,40,30] and [3,4,3] are the same table.

width.description: Table width as a percentage of the text column.

keepNext.description: Keep on the same page as the block after it: a chart with its caption, a table with the note under it.

header.description: A header row: bold, filled #E7E7E7 unless the cell says otherwise, and repeated at the top of every page the table continues on.

rowSpan.description: Written HTML-style: the cell appears ONCE, and the rows it covers list only their own remaining cells.

language.description: Not drawn in a PDF yet (warnings say so).

keepNext.description: Keep on the same page as the block after it: a chart with its caption, a table with the note under it.

widthPx.description: Width in px at 96 dpi; capped at the text column.

heightPx.description: Height in px at 96 dpi. With only one of the two, the other keeps the aspect ratio.

alt.description: Not carried by a PDF from this writer yet (warnings say so).

keepNext.description: Keep on the same page as the block after it: a chart with its caption, a table with the note under it.

page.description: Change the page from here on: {"type": "pageBreak", "page": {"orientation": "landscape", "margins": {"left": 28.8, "right": 28.8}}}. Pages after the break keep every setting until another break names a change; portrait does not come back by itself. margins merge side by side, every other key is replaced whole. {} starts a new stretch with nothing changed. Only on a top-level break, not one in a quote or a table cell.

header.description: A running header on every page: a one-line band, or blocks (a letterhead with a logo). With a firstHeader, every page but the first; with an evenHeader, the odd pages.

footer.description: A running footer on every page: where a multi-page document carries its page numbers. With a firstFooter, every page but the first; with an evenFooter, the odd pages.

firstHeader.description: The header of the FIRST page only, in place of header there. {"blocks": []} leaves that page with no header. On a pageBreak it means the first page after that break. Never inherited by a later break.

firstFooter.description: The footer of the first page only, in place of footer there. {"blocks": []} leaves that page with no footer. On a pageBreak it means the first page after that break. Never inherited by a later break.

evenHeader.description: The header of even pages; header is then the odd pages'. Follows the page number, which runs through the whole document and does not restart at a break.

evenFooter.description: The footer of even pages; footer is then the odd pages'. Follows the page number, which runs through the whole document and does not restart at a break.

border.description: A frame around every page, measured from the page edge, so it is the same whatever the page holds (a certificate border). e.g. {"style": "double", "width": 6, "color": "#B08D57", "inset": 18}. Margins are separate: keep them wider than inset + width so text clears the frame.

style.description: single by default; double draws two rules with a gap, each a third of the width; none draws nothing.

width.description: Points, the whole frame (both rules and the gap, for double). 0.5 by default.

inset.description: Points from the page edge to the outside of the frame. 24 by default.

keepNext.description: Keep on the same page as the block after it: a chart with its caption, a table with the note under it.

portable.description: Portable content (fancyContent 1) from another document package, e.g. a spreadsheet range from holy-sheet extract(). Placed as is: validateAndRepair and the writer expand it into headings, paragraphs, lists, images and tables (numbers right-aligned, header rows marked). Pass it through unchanged rather than retyping it.

source.description: Where the content came from: {package, kind, version, sourceKind, selector}.

v.description: The typed value: a string, number or boolean; date YYYY-MM-DD; datetime YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ; error a string starting with #. Absent for empty.

text.description: The display string the source showed, when it differs from the value.

formula.description: Metadata only: never evaluated, never written. The value is written.

level.description: Required for a heading, forbidden otherwise.

ref.description: A key of `images`. Never a URL or a path.

data.description: Standard base64 of the PNG or JPEG bytes.

report.description: What the reader lost or approximated: {dropped, approximated, guard}.
